SPIRETALK-MERCHANT_WRECK.title: The Overturned Cart
SPIRETALK-MERCHANT_WRECK.pages.INITIAL.d: A familiar cart lies on its side by the path. Jars and bottles everywhere, and [gold]{Npc}[/gold] on hands and knees in the dirt, gathering them one by one and muttering.
SPIRETALK-MERCHANT_WRECK.pages.INITIAL.o: Broken glass everywhere. Kneel and lend a hand.
Nobody is watching. Something has rolled to your feet.
SPIRETALK-MERCHANT_WRECK.pages.TALK.sile: [gold]{Npc}[/gold] is too busy picking things up to answer.
SPIRETALK-MERCHANT_WRECK.pages.HELP.desc:
You kneel to help and slice a hand on broken glass. When it's done, [gold]{Npc}[/gold] presses a potion into your palm.

Lost [red]5[/red] HP. Gained a potion and [gold]The Merchant's Favour[/gold]: everything at the next shop costs [gold]15%[/gold] less, card removal included.
SPIRETALK-MERCHANT_WRECK.pages.POCKET.de:
While [gold]{Npc}[/gold] is bent over the mess, [gold]{Relic}[/gold] slips into your pack. You look up straight into those eyes.

Gained [gold]{Relic}[/gold], and [red]The Merchant's Grudge[/red]: every shop costs [red]15%[/red] more for the rest of this run.
SPIRETALK-MERCHANT_WRECK.pages.WALK_ON.d:
You step around the mess and keep going. Behind you:

{Words}
You step around the mess and keep going.
SPIRETALK-ANCIENT_REST.title: An Ancient by the Road
SPIRETALK-ANCIENT_REST.pages.INITIAL.des:
Far from their own domain, [gold]{Npc}[/gold] sits on a stone by the path, more worn out than you have ever seen them.

{Ask}
SPIRETALK-ANCIENT_REST.askNothing: [gold]{Npc}[/gold] asks for nothing, only shifts over to leave you half the stone.
SPIRETALK-ANCIENT_REST.pages.INITIAL.opt: Hand over the gold you were asked for.
Sit down on the other half of the stone.
Shake your head and keep going.
SPIRETALK-ANCIENT_REST.pages.TALK.silent: [gold]{Npc}[/gold] keeps their eyes closed and says nothing.
SPIRETALK-ANCIENT_REST.pages.THANKS.desc:
[gold]{Npc}[/gold] lays a hand on your deck. [gold]{Card}[/gold] grows stronger.

{Words}
[gold]{Npc}[/gold] lays a hand on your deck. [gold]{Card}[/gold] grows stronger.
SPIRETALK-ANCIENT_REST.pages.DECLINE.des:
You move on. Behind you, [gold]{Npc}[/gold]'s voice:

{Words}
